Contextual work objects support the task. Crisp professional realistic UI with sharp square corners. No floating UI outside devices, no decorative pop-up cards, no artificial shadow around the photograph, no watermark, no CODEYEA branding. No standalone screenshot. Natural materials and realistic device perspective. Generate directly at the requested aspect ratio; do not create a montage of separate photos. Landscape 1440x1080, aspect 4:3. Close slightly elevated three-quarter view of a large desktop monitor with a smaller open laptop beside it on an equipment company's technical workspace. Monitor occupies most of the frame, laptop secondary. No people. Small brushed metal sample and a folded engineering specification sheet at the edge give relevant context. Neutral daylight with navy and teal interface accents. The desktop screen displays a beautifully finished custom content editor named MODULO CMS. Large legible title Equipment editor, left navigation Pages / Equipment / Media. Editing equipment model PX-40, with meaningful fields Model name, Applications, Technical files, and a product photo of industrial equipment. Upper right a square teal button Preview and a smaller Save draft button. The laptop shows the finished elegant NORTHLINE EQUIPMENT product website with a large clean equipment photo and concise product heading PX-40. Interface should feel like an actual premium professional content management application with thoughtful typography and breathing room, not a simplistic flowchart or empty grid. Device screen faces camera enough to clearly understand the actual fields. Keep all devices inside the photo.
